title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.8 (Peaked November 19, 2026 at 17:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 412 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)

Things are pretty calm. 💛

Several active regions and a small sunspot group are visible today, while the coronagraph view appears routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
